description:
Convert legacy Quattro Pro spreadsheets to XLSX, PDF, HTML, Markdown, CSV, or XLS without uploading confidential finance, operations, engineering, or compliance data to the cloud.

Bulk-convert legacy Quattro Pro spreadsheets (.qpw, .wq1, .wq2, .wb1, .wb2, .wb3) to XLSX, PDF, HTML, Markdown, CSV, and XLS locally on Windows.
LibreOffice is bundled with the installer, so no additional software is required.
